name: Bone (Paragon Hag Family)
body:
Believing themselves masters of the undead, bone hags* are natural necromancers. They pass along that power to their families.

Family Spells: chill touch (3rd), command undead (6th), undead anatomy I (9th), contagion (12th), undead anatomy II (15th), circle of death (18th)
Ritual Spells–Knowledge (Religion): animate dead (5th), raise dead (7th), create undead (9th), symbol of weakness (11th), create greater undead (13th), cursed earth (15th), empowered sympathetic* harm (17th), sympathetic* energy drain (19th)
Family Powers: The families of bone hags grow ever closer to mastery over death.
Skeletal Form (Ex)

You gain damage reduction 2/bludgeoning. At 4th level and every four levels thereafter, this damage reduction increases by 2.

Channel Negative Energy (Su)

At 4th level, you can channel negative energy as an evil cleric of your paragon hag level. This counts as the channel energy class feature to meet the prerequisites for feats like Command Undead and Extra Channel. Bone hag paragon levels stack with cleric levels for purposes of determining channel effects and damage.

Death; Senses (Su)

At 8th level, you are constantly under the effects of detect undead and can sense the condition of your coven members as though with status.

Stolen Life (Su)

At 12th level, when you strike a living creature with your claws, you may spend a soul point as a swift action to affect the struck creature as vampiric touch instead of dealing normal damage.

Life in Death (Ex)

At 16th level, you are healed by both positive and negative energy.

Legendary Family

Upon reaching 20th level, you have become one with death. You are now immune to death effects, disease, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, and stunning. Further, if any effect would treat you as alive or undead, you may choose which it treats you as.
